# CertCram Pro workspace instructions

Read repository-root `AGENTS.md` first. This repository contains a **working but incomplete** Next.js application, not an empty starter kit. Preserve existing functionality and work incrementally.

- Follow `docs/FEATURES.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/CONTENT_STANDARDS.md`, and `docs/ROADMAP.md`.
- Treat `references/screenshots/` and `references/video/` as OPTIONAL local, third-party reference material; do not publish, copy, or commit it.
- Reuse the existing UI and feature engines. Adding certifications creates content packages; it must not re-scaffold the application.
- Consult official exam-provider documentation before changing exam facts. Never use exam dumps.
- Never claim that demo questions, partially supported certification profiles, or shallow lessons represent a complete certification course.
- Run `npm run verify` and browser tests when possible; report exactly what passed and what was not run.
- Do not require paid services or private credentials for the core app.
